verdict.rationale: ADK is an open-source framework (adk-python) that can be run and deployed manually via Docker/container images on any infrastructure, explicitly documented as suitable for offline/disconnected environments with no Google Cloud dependency, alongside self-hosted CLI/dev tools (adk run, adk web, adk deploy docker). Cloud Run/GKE/Agent Runtime are offered only as optional managed deployment targets, not requirements. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on report confirming a fully vendor-free production deployment at scale.
